questions.q: Which tag must every item in a list be wrapped in?
questions.qAf: In watter etiket moet elke item in 'n lys toegedraai word?
questions.explain: Every list item is wrapped in <li>, inside a <ul> (bulleted) or <ol> (numbered) list.
questions.explainAf: Elke lysitem word in <li> toegedraai, binne 'n <ul>- (kolpunt-) of <ol>- (genommerde) lys.

questions.q: A learner wants a picture that opens a website when it is clicked. What must they do?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder wil 'n prent hê wat 'n webwerf oopmaak wanneer daarop geklik word. Wat moet die leerder doen?
options: Add a border to the image
questions.explain: A clickable image is an wrapped inside an tag. List items can be made clickable the same way.
questions.explainAf: 'n Klikbare prent is 'n wat binne 'n -etiket toegedraai is. Lysitems kan op dieselfde manier klikbaar gemaak word.

questions.q: Which way of applying CSS is the worst and should be avoided?
questions.qAf: Watter manier om CSS toe te pas, is die swakste en moet vermy word?
questions.explain: Inline CSS (a style attribute inside a tag) is the worst: you must style each line separately. External CSS is preferred.
questions.explainAf: Inlyn-CSS ('n style-attribuut binne 'n etiket) is die swakste: jy moet elke reël afsonderlik stileer. Eksterne CSS word verkies.

questions.q: Which pointer appears on the edge of a cell so you can drag its content to a new place?
questions.qAf: Watter wyser verskyn op die rand van 'n sel sodat jy die inhoud na 'n nuwe plek kan sleep?
questions.explain: The four-way arrow moves content. The tiny black plus is the Fill Handle, the large white plus selects cells and the black arrow selects a whole row or column.
questions.explainAf: Die vierrigtingpyl skuif inhoud. Die klein swart plus is die vulhandvatsel, die groot wit plus kies selle en die swart pyl kies 'n hele ry of kolom.

questions.q: Cells A1 to A5 hold: 4, 8, (empty), Absent, 12. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A5) give?
questions.qAf: Selle A1 tot A5 bevat: 4, 8, (leeg), Afwesig, 12. Wat gee =AVERAGE(A1:A5)?
questions.explain: AVERAGE ignores text and blanks: (4 + 8 + 12) ÷ 3 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE ignoreer teks en leë selle: (4 + 8 + 12) ÷ 3 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

questions.q: A map shows only roads and landmarks, not every blade of grass. Which pillar of computational thinking is this?
questions.qAf: 'n Kaart wys net paaie en landmerke, nie elke grashalm nie. Watter pilaar van berekeningsdenke is dit?
questions.explain: Abstraction hides unnecessary detail to focus on what matters.
questions.explainAf: Abstraksie versteek onnodige besonderhede om op die belangrike te fokus.

questions.q: Which variable name follows the camelCase convention?
questions.qAf: Watter veranderlikenaam volg die camelCase-konvensie?
questions.explain: camelCase starts small and capitalises the next words: playerScore. Upper CamelCase (PlayerScore) is for classes.
questions.explainAf: camelCase begin met 'n kleinletter en gee die volgende woorde 'n hoofletter: playerScore. Upper CamelCase (PlayerScore) is vir klasse.

questions.q: What is a fillet in FreeCAD?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n fillet (afronding) in FreeCAD?
options: A rounded edge on a sharp corner
A hole cut into a face
A guide line that is not part of the model
optionsAf: 'n Gat wat in 'n vlak gesny word
'n Hulplyn wat nie deel van die model is nie
questions.explain: A fillet rounds a sharp corner, which is weak and unsafe; the radius sets how rounded it is. A hole is a Pocket, and a guide line is a construction line.
questions.explainAf: 'n Fillet rond 'n skerp hoek af, wat swak en onveilig is; die radius bepaal hoe rond dit is. 'n Gat is 'n Pocket, en 'n hulplyn is 'n konstruksielyn.

questions.q: A voltmeter reads 6 V and an ammeter reads 0.02 A. What is the resistance?
questions.qAf: 'n Voltmeter lees 6 V en 'n ammeter lees 0,02 A. Wat is die weerstand?

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: is a self-closing tag.
questions.qAf: is 'n selfsluitende etiket.
questions.explain:
(a line break),
and are self-closing: they do not wrap content.
questions.explainAf:
('n reëlbreuk),
en is selfsluitend: hulle omsluit nie inhoud nie.

questions.q: Sorting in Excel temporarily hides data that does not meet your criteria.
questions.qAf: Sortering in Excel versteek tydelik data wat nie aan jou kriteria voldoen nie.
questions.explain: Sorting changes the order (A–Z, 1–30). Filtering is what temporarily hides data.
questions.explainAf: Sortering verander die volgorde (A–Z, 1–30). Filtrering is wat data tydelik versteek.

questions.q: An algorithm may use vague steps, because a robot will work out what you mean.
questions.qAf: 'n Algoritme mag vae stappe gebruik, want 'n robot sal uitwerk wat jy bedoel.
questions.explain: Algorithms must be precise. Computers and robots have no intuition, so vague steps cause errors.
questions.explainAf: Algoritmes moet presies wees. Rekenaars en robotte het geen intuïsie nie, dus veroorsaak vae stappe foute.

questions.q: A for loop has three parts: initialisation, condition and increment.
questions.qAf: 'n for-lus het drie dele: inisialisering, voorwaarde en inkrement.
questions.explain: For example: int counter = 0; counter < 5; counter++.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld: int counter = 0; counter < 5; counter++.

questions.q: Construction lines appear blue in FreeCAD.
questions.qAf: Konstruksielyne verskyn blou in FreeCAD.
questions.explain: Turn on construction mode before drawing; the guide lines appear blue and are never part of the 3D model.
questions.explainAf: Skakel konstruksiemodus aan voordat jy teken; die hulplyne verskyn blou en is nooit deel van die 3D-model nie.

questions.q: Analog output on the Arduino accepts values from 0 to 1023.
questions.qAf: Analoë uitset op die Arduino aanvaar waardes van 0 tot 1023.
questions.explain: Analog input gives 0 to 1023; analog output accepts 0 to 255.
questions.explainAf: Analoë inset gee 0 tot 1023; analoë uitset aanvaar 0 tot 255.

questions.q: Swapping the positive and negative wires of a DC motor makes it turn the other way.
questions.qAf: As jy die positiewe en negatiewe drade van 'n GS-motor omruil, draai dit die ander kant toe.
questions.explain: Polarity is the direction of electrical flow; swapping it reverses the motor.
questions.explainAf: Polariteit is die rigting van die elektriese vloei; as jy dit omruil, draai die motor om.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each chart type in column A with what it is best for in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke grafiektipe in kolom A by waarvoor dit die beste is in kolom B.
pairs: Proportions or percentages of a whole
Like a line chart but filled in, to show the volume of change
pairsAf: Soos 'n lyngrafiek maar ingekleur, om die omvang van verandering te wys
extra: Relationships between two sets of values
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is a scatter plot.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is 'n spreidingsdiagram (scatter plot).

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each part of jGRASP to what it does.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke deel van jGRASP aan wat dit doen.
questions.explain: The Plus (+) button compiles: it checks for syntax errors and creates the .class file.
questions.explainAf: Die Plus- (+-)knoppie stel saam (compile): dit soek na sintaksfoute en skep die .class-lêer.

questions.q: Match each Arduino connection or tool in column A with its use in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke Arduino-aansluiting of -hulpmiddel in kolom A by sy gebruik in kolom B.
pairs: LEDs and buzzers, fully on or off
Motor speed control and dimming lights
Prints input readings on the screen for debugging
pairsAf: LED's en zoemers, heeltemal aan of af
Druk insetlesings op die skerm vir ontfouting
extra: Loads a program onto the Arduino through USB
extraAf: Laai 'n program via USB op die Arduino
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the serial port (the USB port).
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die seriepoort (die USB-poort).

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the lines of the Hello World program in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die reëls van die Hello World-program in die korrekte volgorde.
questions.explain: Import first, then the class (its name matches the file), then the main method (the entry point), then the command that prints.
questions.explainAf: Eers die import, dan die klas (sy naam pas by die lêer), dan die main-metode (die beginpunt), dan die opdrag wat druk.

questions.q: Put the steps for modelling a plate with rounded corners and a slot in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n plaat met afgeronde hoeke en 'n gleuf te modelleer, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Sketch the outline on the XY plane
Add distance constraints until the sketch turns green
Pad the sketch into a 3D part
stepsAf: Skets die buitelyn op die XY-vlak
Voeg afstandbeperkings by totdat die skets groen word
Gebruik Pad om 'n 3D-onderdeel van die skets te maak
questions.explain: Outline → constraints until green → fillet the corners → slot → check for zero DOF → Pad → Save As.
questions.explainAf: Buitelyn → beperkings totdat dit groen is → rond die hoeke af → gleuf → kyk vir nul DOF → Pad → Save As.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Sello writes this program for his Gogga, rex.
questions.scenarioAf: Sello skryf hierdie program vir sy Gogga, rex.

questions.q: How many times does rex turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai rex regs?
questions.explain: Both rex.move() and rex.turnRight() are inside the loop, which runs 5 times (counter 0 to 4).
questions.explainAf: Albei rex.move() en rex.turnRight() is binne die lus, wat 5 keer uitgevoer word (counter 0 tot 4).

questions.q: Sello wants rex to move 8 times. What should the condition be?
questions.qAf: Sello wil hê rex moet 8 keer beweeg. Wat moet die voorwaarde wees?
questions.explain: Starting at 0, counter < 8 runs for 0 to 7: 8 times.
questions.explainAf: Met 0 as begin word counter < 8 vir 0 tot 7 uitgevoer: 8 keer.

questions.q: Which part of the loop is int counter = 0?
questions.qAf: Watter deel van die lus is int counter = 0?
questions.explain: Initialisation sets the starting value; counter < 5 is the condition and counter++ the increment.
questions.explainAf: Inisialisering stel die beginwaarde; counter < 5 is die voorwaarde en counter++ die inkrement.

questions.q: In rex.move(), what is move()?
questions.qAf: Wat is move() in rex.move()?
questions.explain: Object name, full stop, method. Methods are what an object does; fields are what it is (X, Y, colour).
questions.explainAf: Objeknaam, punt, metode. Metodes is wat 'n objek doen; velde is wat dit is (X, Y, kleur).

questions.scenario: Zola uses a potentiometer to control the brightness of an LED: one side goes to 5 V, the other to ground, and the middle pin to A0.
questions.scenarioAf: Zola gebruik 'n potensiometer om die helderheid van 'n LED te beheer: een kant gaan na 5 V, die ander na grond (GND), en die middelste pen na A0.

questions.q: What is the middle pin of the potentiometer called?
questions.qAf: Wat word die middelste pen van die potensiometer genoem?
questions.explain: A potentiometer is a voltage divider with a central wiper, like a volume control or dimmer.
questions.explainAf: 'n Potensiometer is 'n spanningsdeler met 'n sleper in die middel, soos 'n volumebeheer of dowwer.

questions.q: The reading on A0 is 1000. Which value should she send to the LED?
questions.qAf: Die lesing op A0 is 1000. Watter waarde moet sy na die LED stuur?
questions.explain: Map 0–1023 to 0–255 by dividing by 4: 1000 ÷ 4 = 250.
questions.explainAf: Beeld 0–1023 op 0–255 af deur met 4 te deel: 1000 ÷ 4 = 250.

questions.q: Why must the reading be mapped first?
questions.qAf: Hoekom moet die lesing eers afgebeeld (mapped) word?
options: The LED needs a negative value
optionsAf: Die LED het 'n negatiewe waarde nodig
questions.explain: Analog input gives 0 to 1023, but analog output accepts 0 to 255. Without mapping, the value could be far above 255.
questions.explainAf: Analoë inset gee 0 tot 1023, maar analoë uitset aanvaar 0 tot 255. Sonder afbeelding kan die waarde ver bo 255 wees.

questions.q: A potentiometer works like a volume control or a dimmer.
questions.qAf: 'n Potensiometer werk soos 'n volumebeheer of 'n dowwer.
questions.explain: Turning it moves the wiper, which changes the voltage on the analog pin.
questions.explainAf: As jy dit draai, beweeg die sleper, wat die spanning op die analoë pen verander.

questions.scenario: A school's gate opens by itself when a camera recognises a number plate. A program checks the plate against a list, and a motor opens the gate. The controller does only this one job.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Skool se hek gaan vanself oop wanneer 'n kamera 'n nommerplaat herken. 'n Program kyk of die nommerplaat op 'n lys is, en 'n motor maak die hek oop. Die beheerder doen net hierdie een taak.

questions.q: In the IPO cycle, what is the camera?
questions.qAf: Wat is die kamera in die IPO-siklus?
questions.explain: The camera reads the environment, so it is the input.
questions.explainAf: Die kamera lees die omgewing, dus is dit die inset.

questions.q: In the IPO cycle, what is the gate motor?
questions.qAf: Wat is die hekmotor in die IPO-siklus?
questions.explain: The motor acts on the world, so it is an actuator: the output.
questions.explainAf: Die motor werk op die wêreld in, dus is dit 'n aktuator: die uitset.

questions.q: The controller is built for this one job only. What is it?
questions.qAf: Die beheerder is net vir hierdie een taak gebou. Wat is dit?
questions.explain: An embedded system is a specialised computer for one dedicated job, like a router or a microwave controller.
questions.explainAf: 'n Ingebedde stelsel is 'n gespesialiseerde rekenaar vir een toegewyde taak, soos 'n roeteerder of 'n mikrogolfbeheerder.

questions.q: Which kind of chip combines a processor, memory and I/O ports on one chip?
questions.qAf: Watter soort skyfie kombineer 'n verwerker, geheue en I/O-poorte op een skyfie?
questions.explain: A microcontroller is self-contained, like the ATmega on the Arduino. A microprocessor needs a separate motherboard, memory and I/O controllers.
questions.explainAf: 'n Mikrobeheerder is selfstandig, soos die ATmega op die Arduino. 'n Mikroverwerker het 'n aparte moederbord, geheue en I/O-beheerders nodig.
